name: B3F-4055
title: Through-hole tactile switch family, 6 × 6 mm and 12 × 12 mm
summary: The B3F is a through-hole tactile pushbutton family with one normally open contact, rated 1 to 50 mA at 3 to 24 VDC. It comes in 6 × 6 mm and 12 × 12 mm top-operated bodies, a side-operated 6 × 6 mm body and a 6 × 6 mm body on radial tape, with flat or projected plungers, silver or gold contacts and optional ground terminal. B3F-4055 is the 12 × 12 mm projected-plunger switch with a 2.55 N operating force and no ground terminal.

notes: Bagged models come 100 to a bag and are ordered in multiples of a bag.
Taped radial models come 1,000 to a package, are ordered in multiples of a package and are not sold singly.
B3F-1052-G is listed in the side-operated gold-plated group; its outline is the top-operated 6 × 6 mm projected-plunger outline of B3F-1050.
B3F-4055: 12 × 12 mm, silver contacts, projected plunger 7.3 mm high, 2.55 N {260 gf}, yellow plunger, no ground terminal, bag of 100.

operation.text: Each B3F has one normally open contact (SPST-NO). Pretravel is 0.25 mm on 6 × 6 mm parts and 0.3 mm on 12 × 12 mm parts; operating and releasing forces depend on the model. Bounce time is 5 ms max.

Top-operated switches come in 6 × 6 mm (B3F-1000 series) and 12 × 12 mm (B3F-4000, long-durability B3F-5000, gold-plated B3F-5001) bodies; the B3F-3000 series presses from the side; the B3F-6000 series is the 6 × 6 mm switch on radial tape for automatic insertion. Plungers are flat or projected, in several heights and operating forces, each force with its own plunger color.

The gold-plated B3F-G models are rated 100 μA to 50 mA. Omron offers gold contacts for higher contact reliability, resistance to corrosive gas and protection against insulation failure from ion migration in harsh environments.

Life depends on the series and the operating force: from 50,000 operations for the 4.9 N 6 × 6 mm parts to 10,000,000 for the B3F-5000/5001. The B3F-4055, a 2.55 N B3F-4000 part, is rated for 1,000,000 operations minimum.

Models with a ground terminal add a fifth pin (third on the radial parts) tied to a metal plate inside the switch and isolated from the contacts. The side-operated parts ground through their two frame legs.
B32-series key tops fit the projected-plunger models.
The switch is IP00 and cannot be washed. PCB hole patterns are given for a 1.6 mm board.
